name: Copyleaks
tagline: Copyleaks is a plagiarism detection and AI content identification platform that scans text for both traditional plagiarism and AI-generated content. It supports 100+ languages and integrates with Moodle, Canvas, and major LMS platforms. Educational institutions use it to maintain academic integrity in the age of generative AI.
